releaseNotes:
Startup Splash & Logo Refinement: Pure pitch-black AMOLED background and seamless Android 12+ splash screen integration, eliminating OEM container cuts/slashes and stray acoustic lines.
Update Downloader Improvements: Clicking 'Later' during download cleanly cancels OkHttp network streaming, purges partial files, and safely dismisses without background activity.
Refined Turntable Brandmark: Precision vinyl grooves, balanced spindle hub, and iconic play glyph.
